releases.name: Version 1.0.4
releases.body: - Fixed a conflict with New Horizons where warping from another star system back to the Outer Wilds would cause an infinite loading screen (thank you Yub3l for reporting this).
releases.bodyZh: - 修复了与《新视野》的冲突，从另一个星系传送回星际拓荒会导致无限加载屏幕（感谢 Yub3l 报告此问题）。

releases.name: Version 1.0.3
releases.body: - Fixed ship log HUD markers vanishing with NH installed
releases.bodyZh: - 修复了在安装NH后飞船日志HUD标记消失的问题

releases.name: Version 1.0.2
releases.body: - Add Patreon donation link to mod manifest
releases.bodyZh: - 在模组清单中添加Patreon捐赠链接

releases.name: v1.0.1
releases.body: - Fixes a bug where Slate wouldn't shut up.
releases.bodyZh: - 修复了斯莱特不停唠叨的bug。
